lead_raw_text:
The structure of CuBiF₅ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4/mmm (No. 194), with a unit cell containing seven atoms—Cu, Bi, and five F—distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis identifies tetrahedral CuF₄ and octahedral BiF₆ environments, with Bi centers coordinated by six F neighbors. The CuF₄ tetrahedra share corners with one another and with BiF₆ octahedra, while BiF₆ octahedra share corners, edges, and faces with CuF₄ tetrahedra; the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all seven sites.
